title: Samsung Galaxy A50 Unboxing & First Look - Great Features Killer Price:fire::fire::fire:
description: Namaskaar dosto, is video mein maine aapse baat ki hai samsung ke brand new a series ke baare mein, galaxy a series mein samsung ne aaj teen naye pheones launch kiye hai galaxy aur galaxy aur aur galaxy a 30 Galaxy A50. Maine aapse is video mein samsung galaxy a50 ki unboxing aur first look kiya hai jaha is phone mein hai 6.4 "ka ek fhd+ super amoled display hai, infinity u cut ke saath mein, samsung exynos 9610 octacore processor hai 10nm based. Charging Ka Support Bhi Available Hai. Samsung Galaxy A50 Ke Do Variants Hai Jaha Pe Ek Hai 4GB Ram + 64GB Storage Ke Saath Aur Ek Hai 6GB Ram + 64GB Storage Ke Saath, Galaxy Aapko Ek Triple Slot Milta Hai Memory Card Aur Sim Cards Ke Liye Aur Saath Mein UsB-C port hai Charging Ke Liye.   Galaxy A50 Price: 4GB + 64GB - 19,990inr 6GB + 64GB - 22,990inr  Share, support, subscribe !!!
